intent.ko: 어제 무엇을 끝냈고 오늘은 무엇을 할지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them what you finished yesterday and what you are moving on to today.

wk_003.sample_en: I finished the draft yesterday, and today I'm moving on to the test results. There was one small issue with the data.

sample_gloss.ko: 어제 초안을 끝냈고 오늘은 테스트 결과로 넘어간다는 뜻이에요. 데이터에 작은 문제가 하나 있었다고 덧붙였어요.
sample_gloss.en: You finished the draft yesterday and are starting on the test results today, and you mention one small data problem.

intent.ko: 어느 팀에서 주로 어떤 일을 맡고 있는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them which team you are on and what you mainly take care of.

gloss.en: I belong to the support team
I am mainly in charge of

wk_005.sample_en: I'm on the support team, and I mostly handle orders from our overseas clients. Day to day, that means a lot of email.

sample_gloss.ko: 지원팀에서 해외 거래처 주문을 주로 맡고 있고, 평소에는 메일 업무가 많다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You are on the support team, you mainly handle overseas client orders, and most days that means a lot of email.

intent.ko: 소리가 끊겨 미안하다고 하고 일정 이야기를 다시 말해보세요
intent.en: Say your audio dropped, then say your point about the schedule again.

wk_008.sample_en: Sorry about the audio. Let me say that again: the launch date may get pushed back a week.

sample_gloss.ko: 소리가 끊긴 것을 사과하고, 출시 날짜가 일주일 밀릴 수 있다는 말을 다시 전하는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize for the audio trouble and repeat that the launch date may slip by a week.

intent.ko: 내일 회의에서 다룰 것 두 가지를 정해서 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the two things you want tomorrow's meeting to cover.

wk_011.sample_en: Two things mainly. I'd like to go over the budget first, and then the timeline for next quarter.

sample_gloss.ko: 크게 두 가지를 다루자는 뜻이에요. 예산을 먼저 보고, 그다음에 다음 분기 일정을 보자고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You want to cover two things: the budget first, and after that next quarter's timeline.

intent.ko: 목요일은 어렵고 며칠 더 필요하다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say Thursday is too tight and ask for a few more days.

gloss.en: is Monday all right for you?

wk_014.sample_en: Thursday would be tight. If I could have a couple more days for the checks, would Monday work?

sample_gloss.ko: 목요일까지는 빠듯하다는 뜻이에요. 확인할 시간이 이틀쯤 더 있으면 월요일은 어떤지 물었어요.
sample_gloss.en: Thursday is too tight, and you ask whether Monday would work if you get two or three more days for checks.

intent.ko: 공장 일정이 밀려 샘플이 늦어진다고 알리고 새 날짜를 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them the factory is behind and give the new date for the samples.

wk_017.sample_en: The factory is running a bit behind, so we can ship next Friday instead. I'll keep you posted if anything changes.

sample_gloss.ko: 공장 일정이 조금 밀려서 다음 금요일에 보낼 수 있다는 뜻이에요. 달라지면 계속 알려주겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: The factory is a little behind, so the samples ship next Friday instead, and you will keep them updated.

intent.ko: 무엇이 잘못됐고 지금 어떻게 하고 있는지 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Say briefly what went wrong and what you are doing about it now.

wk_020.sample_en: The short version is that one batch was affected by a labeling error. We're already working on it and I'll have numbers by noon.

sample_gloss.ko: 라벨 오류로 한 묶음이 영향을 받았다는 뜻이에요. 이미 처리 중이고 정오까지 숫자를 드리겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: In short, one batch was hit by a labeling error, you are already on it, and numbers will come by noon.

intent.ko: 원자재 값이 올라 견적이 높아졌다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them the quote is higher because material costs went up this year.

gloss.en: it is about the raw material

wk_023.sample_en: The difference is on the raw material, which is up since last year. Everything else is at the same margin as before.

sample_gloss.ko: 차이가 난 건 원자재 쪽이고 작년보다 값이 올랐다는 뜻이에요. 나머지는 예전과 같은 이윤이라고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: The gap comes from the raw material, which costs more than last year, while everything else keeps the same margin.

intent.ko: 일정 단축이 무리라고 생각하는 이유를 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you think the shorter schedule is too tight, and give your reason.

wk_026.sample_en: I'm a little worried about the testing time. What if we keep the date but drop one of the smaller features?

sample_gloss.ko: 테스트 시간이 걱정된다는 뜻이에요. 날짜는 그대로 두고 작은 기능 하나를 빼면 어떻겠냐고 제안했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You are concerned about the testing time and suggest keeping the date but dropping one smaller feature.

intent.ko: 숫자가 틀린 경위를 인정하고 어떻게 바로잡았는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say how the wrong number got in and how you are fixing it.

wk_029.sample_en: That was my mistake. I pulled the old file by accident, so I've already sent a correction to everyone on the list.

sample_gloss.ko: 본인 실수였다고 인정하는 뜻이에요. 예전 파일을 잘못 썼고, 받은 사람 모두에게 정정본을 이미 보냈다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You own the mistake, explain you used the old file by accident, and say a correction already went to everyone.

intent.ko: 예약이 있는데 확인이 안 된다고 하고 다시 찾아봐 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have a booking that is not showing, and ask them to look again.

wk_031.sample_en: I'm checking in tonight, but it may be saved under the company name instead of mine. Could you check again?

sample_gloss.ko: 오늘 밤 체크인인데 예약이 회사 이름으로 되어 있을 수 있다는 뜻이에요. 다시 확인해 달라고 부탁했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You are checking in tonight, the booking may be under the company name, and you ask them to look again.

intent.ko: 생산 라인에 대해 무엇이 궁금한지 한 가지만 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have one question about how the line runs, and ask it.

wk_034.sample_en: I do have one question about output. How many units does this line run in a shift?

sample_gloss.ko: 생산량에 대해 하나 묻고 싶다는 뜻이에요. 이 라인이 한 교대에 몇 개를 만드는지 물었어요.
sample_gloss.en: You have one question about output and ask how many units this line produces in a single shift.

intent.ko: 지금 어디까지 왔고 무엇이 남았는지 한두 문장으로 말해보세요
intent.en: Say where the project stands now and what is still left.

wk_037.sample_en: We're about halfway through and on schedule so far. The one thing left this month is the client review.

sample_gloss.ko: 절반쯤 왔고 아직 일정대로라는 뜻이에요. 이번 달에 남은 건 고객 검토 하나라고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You are about halfway and still on schedule, and the only thing left this month is the client review.

intent.ko: 오늘 저녁은 어렵지만 다른 날은 괜찮다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say tonight does not work for you, and offer another day.

wk_040.sample_en: I wish I could, but I already have plans tonight. How about tomorrow instead, if your schedule allows?

sample_gloss.ko: 가고 싶지만 오늘은 선약이 있다는 뜻이에요. 일정이 괜찮다면 내일은 어떤지 물었어요.
sample_gloss.en: You would like to go but already have plans tonight, and you offer tomorrow if their schedule allows.

intent.ko: 다섯 시에는 다른 회의가 있고 여섯 시 이후면 된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say five does not work because of another meeting, and offer after six.

gloss.en: five does not work for me
I have a meeting at that hour

wk_042.sample_en: I'm afraid I can't make five. I have another meeting then, but any time after six works for me.

sample_gloss.ko: 다섯 시에는 다른 회의가 있어 어렵다는 뜻이에요. 대신 여섯 시 이후면 언제든 괜찮다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: Five does not work because you have another meeting, but any time after six is fine for you.

intent.ko: 휴가 동안 누구에게 무엇을 물으면 되는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them who to go to for what while you are away next week.

wk_045.sample_en: For anything urgent, please go to the team lead. I'll be back on Monday and can pick up the rest then.

sample_gloss.ko: 급한 일은 팀장에게 물어봐 달라는 뜻이에요. 월요일에 돌아와서 나머지는 이어받겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: Urgent things go to the team lead, and you will pick up the rest when you are back on Monday.

intent.ko: 주문이 들어온 뒤의 순서를 차례대로 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them the steps, in order, from the moment an order comes in.

wk_048.sample_en: First we check that the stock is there. Then it goes to the warehouse team, and once that's done I send the confirmation.

sample_gloss.ko: 먼저 재고를 확인한다는 뜻이에요. 그다음 창고팀으로 넘기고, 그게 끝나면 확인 메일을 보낸다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: First you check the stock, then it goes to the warehouse team, and once that is done you send the confirmation.

intent.ko: 먼저 사과하고 바로 무엇을 해 드릴지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you are sorry, then say exactly what you will do to fix it.

wk_051.sample_en: I'm so sorry about this. Let me send the right one out today at no cost, and we'll collect the wrong item.

sample_gloss.ko: 먼저 사과하는 뜻이에요. 맞는 물건을 오늘 무료로 보내고 잘못 간 물건은 회수하겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize, then say you will send the correct item today at no cost and collect the wrong one.

intent.ko: 지금 예산으로는 어렵고 무엇이 더 필요한지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the budget is not enough, and tell them what it would take.

wk_054.sample_en: Not with this budget, I'm afraid. We're about twenty percent short, so we'd need a little more room or a smaller scope.

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 예산으로는 어렵다는 뜻이에요. 이십 퍼센트쯤 모자라서 예산을 더 받거나 범위를 줄여야 한다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: This budget is not enough; you are about twenty percent short, so you need a bit more room or a smaller scope.

intent.ko: 결정된 내용과 누가 무엇을 할지 짧게 정리해서 말해보세요
intent.en: Say what was agreed and who is doing what next.

wk_057.sample_en: So we agreed on the shorter list for now. I'll take care of the supplier call and send the summary by next Friday.

sample_gloss.ko: 짧은 목록으로 가기로 했다는 뜻이에요. 공급사 통화는 본인이 맡고, 정리본은 다음 금요일까지 보내겠다고 했어요.
sample_gloss.en: You agreed on the shorter list, you will handle the supplier call, and you will send the summary by next Friday.

intent.ko: 세 시는 어렵고 네 시는 괜찮다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say three does not work for you, and suggest four instead.

gloss.en: three does not work for me

sample_001.sample_en: Sorry about that, I can't make three. How about four instead?

sample_gloss.ko: 세 시는 어렵다고 말하고 네 시는 어떤지 물어보는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say three does not work for you and ask whether four would be all right instead.

intent.ko: 비용 자료를 본 뒤 다음 주에 정하자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Suggest waiting until next week so you can look at the cost data first.

wk_060.sample_en: Could we hold off until next week's meeting? I'd like to see the full numbers before we commit.

sample_gloss.ko: 전체 수치를 본 뒤 결정하고 싶으니 다음 주 회의까지 미루자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask to wait until next week's meeting so you can see all the figures before deciding.

intent.ko: 대부분 이해했지만 약어 하나는 뜻을 모르겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you follow most of it, but ask what one acronym means.

wk_061.sample_en: I'm mostly with you, thanks. Quick question though: what does SLA stand for?

sample_gloss.ko: 대부분 이해했다고 하면서 SLA가 무엇의 약자인지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say you follow most of it and ask what SLA is short for.

intent.ko: 좋은 질문이라고 받은 뒤 수치의 출처를 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Acknowledge the question and briefly explain where the number comes from.

gloss.en: that's a fair thing to ask

wk_062.sample_en: Good question. It comes from our online sales only, and I'm happy to share the full breakdown after this.

sample_gloss.ko: 좋은 질문이라며, 그 수치는 온라인 매출만 기준이고 끝나고 세부 자료를 공유하겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The figure is based on online sales only, and you offer to send the full breakdown afterward.

intent.ko: 제 쪽에서 공유가 안 되니 링크를 채팅에 올리겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say sharing isn't working on your side and offer to post a link in the chat.

wk_063.sample_en: Give me a second, it's not working on my end. I'll put the link in the chat for now.

sample_gloss.ko: 제 쪽에서 공유가 안 되니 우선 채팅창에 링크를 올리겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Sharing fails on your side, so you will post the link in the chat for now.

intent.ko: 다음 일정이 있으니 남은 안건은 메일로 하자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have another call and suggest handling the last item by email.

wk_064.sample_en: We're already over time, and I have another call at eleven. Could we pick that up over email?

sample_gloss.ko: 이미 시간이 넘었고 11시에 다른 통화가 있으니 그 안건은 메일로 이어가자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The meeting has run long and you have a call at eleven, so you suggest continuing by email.

intent.ko: 출시 일정을 짧게 다루고 싶다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask to spend a few minutes on the launch date.

wk_065.sample_en: Yes, one thing to add. I'd like to talk about the launch date, five minutes at most.

sample_gloss.ko: 추가할 게 하나 있다며, 출시 일정을 길어야 5분 정도 이야기하고 싶다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You want to add the launch date to the agenda and keep it to five minutes.

intent.ko: 늦어서 미안하고 앞 회의가 길어졌다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Apologize for being late and say your last meeting ran over.

wk_066.sample_en: Sorry I'm late, my last meeting ran over. Please go ahead, I'll catch up.

sample_gloss.ko: 앞 회의가 길어져 늦었다고 사과하고, 따라갈 테니 계속 진행해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize because your previous meeting went long and ask them to carry on.

intent.ko: 내가 이해한 결론을 짧게 말하고 맞는지 확인해 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Repeat the decision as you understood it and check that it is right.

wk_067.sample_en: Just to confirm, we keep the old design and only change the colors. Is that right?

sample_gloss.ko: 기존 디자인은 유지하고 색만 바꾸는 것으로 이해했는데 맞는지 확인하는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You check that the decision is to keep the current design and only change the colors.

intent.ko: 이름과 용건, 다시 연락받을 번호를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give your name, the reason for calling, and a number to call back.

wk_068.sample_en: Hi Mark, this is Minji from Hanul, calling about the May order. You can reach me at 010 1234 5678.

sample_gloss.ko: 한울의 민지인데 5월 주문 건으로 전화했고, 이 번호로 연락 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say who you are, that you are calling about the May order, and leave your number.

intent.ko: 여기는 회계팀이 아니고 연결해 주겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say they have the wrong team and offer to transfer them.

wk_069.sample_en: I'm afraid not, this is the sales team. Let me put you through to accounting.

sample_gloss.ko: 여기는 회계팀이 아니라 영업팀이라며 회계팀으로 연결해 주겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You explain this is sales, not accounting, and offer to transfer the call.

intent.ko: 잠깐 끊어서 400개가 맞는지 다시 확인해 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Politely cut in and check that the quantity is four hundred.

wk_070.sample_en: Sorry to interrupt, just to check. Was that four hundred units on the 12th?

sample_gloss.ko: 말을 끊어 미안하다고 하고, 12일에 400개가 맞는지 확인하는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You cut in politely to check that it is four hundred units on the 12th.

intent.ko: 창고에 확인하고 오늘 3시 전에 다시 전화하겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you will check and call them back before three this afternoon.

wk_071.sample_en: Let me check with the warehouse and call you back before three. Is this number okay?

sample_gloss.ko: 창고에 확인한 뒤 3시 전에 다시 전화하겠다며, 이 번호로 하면 되는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You will ask the warehouse and phone back before three, and check that this number is fine.

intent.ko: 동료도 들을 수 있게 스피커폰으로 바꿔도 되냐고 말해보세요
intent.en: Before starting, ask if you can switch to speaker so a teammate can listen.

wk_072.sample_en: Before we start, is it okay if I put you on speaker? My colleague Jun is here with me.

sample_gloss.ko: 시작 전에 스피커폰으로 바꿔도 되는지 묻고, 동료 준이 같이 있다고 알리는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask if you can switch to speakerphone and say your coworker Jun is with you.

intent.ko: 결정하기 전에 샘플 몇 개를 보내 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask them to send a few samples before you decide.

wk_073.sample_en: Could you send a few samples to our Seoul office? We'd like to test them before we decide.

sample_gloss.ko: 결정하기 전에 시험해 보고 싶으니 서울 사무실로 샘플 몇 개를 보내 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask for some samples at the Seoul office so you can test them before deciding.

intent.ko: 선금은 30%까지만 되고 나머지는 납품 때 내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can only do thirty percent up front and pay the rest on delivery.

wk_074.sample_en: Our policy is thirty percent up front. Could we pay the rest on delivery?

sample_gloss.ko: 회사 방침상 선금은 30%이고 나머지는 납품 때 내도 되는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Company rules allow 30 percent in advance, and you ask to pay the balance when it arrives.

intent.ko: 법무 검토 때문에 다음 주 수요일까지 시간을 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask for time until next Wednesday because legal is still reviewing it.

wk_075.sample_en: It's still with legal, so we need a few more days. Could we say by next Wednesday?

sample_gloss.ko: 아직 법무팀이 검토 중이라 며칠 더 필요하니 다음 주 수요일까지로 하자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Legal is still reviewing it, so you ask to move the date to next Wednesday.

intent.ko: 사과하고 사진을 받으면 이번 주에 교체품을 보내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Apologize, ask for photos, and promise replacements within the week.

wk_076.sample_en: I'm really sorry to hear that. If you send us some photos, we'll ship replacements this week.

sample_gloss.ko: 정말 죄송하다며, 사진을 보내 주면 이번 주에 교체품을 보내겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You apologize and promise to ship new units this week once they share pictures.

intent.ko: 가격은 못 내리지만 대신 배송비를 부담하겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can't lower the price, but offer to cover shipping instead.

gloss.en: the best price we can offer

gloss.ko: 대신 해 드릴 수 있는 건
gloss.en: what we are able to offer

wk_077.sample_en: I'm sorry, this is already our lowest price. What we can do is cover the shipping on your next order.

sample_gloss.ko: 이미 최저가라 더 못 내리지만, 다음 주문의 배송비를 부담하겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The price can't go lower, but you offer to pay for delivery on the next order.

intent.ko: 다음 달 초 사흘 쉬고 싶고 일은 미리 정리하겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask for three days off early next month and say your work will be covered.

gloss.en: at the start of next month

wk_078.sample_en: I'd like to take three days off early next month. I'll have everything covered before I go.

sample_gloss.ko: 다음 달 초에 사흘 쉬고 싶고, 가기 전에 일을 다 처리해 두겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask for three days of leave early next month and promise all work will be handled first.

intent.ko: 오늘 밤은 어렵지만 내일 아침 일찍 끝내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say tonight doesn't work, but offer to finish first thing tomorrow.

wk_079.sample_en: Tonight is difficult for me, I have plans. I can come in first thing tomorrow and have it done by ten.

sample_gloss.ko: 오늘 밤은 선약이 있어 어렵고, 내일 아침 일찍 와서 10시까지 끝내겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You have plans tonight, so you offer to come in early tomorrow and finish by ten.

intent.ko: 수식이 안 되는데 잠깐 봐 줄 수 있는지 말해보세요
intent.en: Say a formula isn't working and ask if they could take a quick look.

wk_080.sample_en: This formula keeps breaking and I can't see why. Do you have a minute for a quick look?

sample_gloss.ko: 이 수식이 계속 오류가 나는데 이유를 모르겠으니 잠깐 봐 줄 수 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say the formula keeps failing and ask if they have a minute to check it.

intent.ko: 전체적으로 좋지만 합계가 틀린 것 같다고 부드럽게 말해보세요
intent.en: Say it looks good overall, but gently point out that the total seems off.

wk_081.sample_en: It looks good overall. The total might be off, though, so could you check it again before sending?

sample_gloss.ko: 전체적으로 좋지만 합계가 틀렸을 수도 있으니 보내기 전에 다시 확인해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It's fine in general, but the total could be wrong, so you ask them to check before sending.

intent.ko: 오늘은 어렵고 다음에 같이 가자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can't today and suggest another time.

wk_082.sample_en: I wish I could, but I'm eating at my desk today. Can I take a rain check?

sample_gloss.ko: 같이 가고 싶지만 오늘은 자리에서 먹어야 하니 다음에 가자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You'd love to go, but you are eating at your workstation today, so you ask for another time.

intent.ko: 맡을 수 있지만 지금 하는 일과 어느 쪽이 먼저냐고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say yes, but ask which should come first, the report or your current work.

wk_083.sample_en: I'm happy to help. I'm also on the client deck this week, so which comes first?

sample_gloss.ko: 기꺼이 맡겠지만 이번 주에 고객 발표 자료도 하고 있으니 무엇이 먼저인지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You agree, but since you are also on the client slides, you ask what the priority is.

intent.ko: 기사가 이름 팻말을 들고 입국장에서 기다린다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them a driver will wait at arrivals holding a sign with their name.

wk_084.sample_en: Our driver will meet you at arrivals, holding a sign with your name. He'll take you straight to the hotel.

sample_gloss.ko: 기사가 이름 팻말을 들고 입국장에서 기다리다가 호텔로 바로 모셔다 드린다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: A driver with a name sign will wait in the arrivals hall and take them straight to the hotel.

intent.ko: 이 층에 누가 있고 다음에 어디로 갈지 말해보세요
intent.en: Tell them who works on this floor and where you will go next.

wk_085.sample_en: This is where the design team sits. After this, we'll head upstairs to the lab.

sample_gloss.ko: 이 층은 디자인팀 자리이고, 다음에는 위층 연구실로 간다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: This floor is where the designers sit, and next you will go up to the lab.

intent.ko: 맵지 않은 불고기를 추천하고 이유를 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Recommend bulgogi, a mild dish, and briefly say why.

gloss.en: if beef is okay for you

wk_086.sample_en: If you like beef, try the bulgogi. It's not spicy at all, and most people love it.

sample_gloss.ko: 소고기를 좋아하면 불고기를 드셔 보라며, 전혀 맵지 않고 다들 좋아한다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: If beef is okay for them, you suggest bulgogi because it has no heat and is a favorite.

intent.ko: 지금 하는 일과 경력, 지원 이유를 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Briefly say what you do now, how long you have done it, and why you applied.

wk_087.sample_en: I currently work in logistics and have done so for five years. Now I'm looking for a bigger role in global sales.

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 물류 분야에서 5년째 일하고 있고, 이제 해외 영업에서 더 큰 역할을 찾고 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You have worked in logistics for five years and now want more responsibility in global sales.

intent.ko: 지금 회사에서 많이 배웠고 이제 더 넓은 시장에서 일하고 싶다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you have learned a lot, but now want to work in a wider market.

wk_088.sample_en: I've learned a lot there, and I'm grateful for that. Now I feel ready for a wider market.

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 회사에서 많이 배웠고 감사하지만, 이제 더 넓은 시장으로 갈 준비가 됐다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You are grateful for what you gained there and now feel prepared for a broader market.

intent.ko: 강점 하나와 그걸 보여 주는 짧은 사례를 말해보세요
intent.en: Name one strength and back it up with a short example.

wk_089.sample_en: I'd say staying organized. For example, last year I ran twelve projects at once and all of them finished on time.

sample_gloss.ko: 체계적인 정리가 강점이라며, 작년에 12개 프로젝트를 동시에 맡아 모두 제때 끝냈다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Your strength is keeping things in order, and last year all twelve of your projects finished by the deadline.

intent.ko: 좋은 지적이라며 바로 고치겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Agree with the suggestion and say you will update it right away.

tr_dev_001.sample_en: Good catch. I'll rename it to calculateTotal and push a fix in a few minutes.

sample_gloss.ko: 좋은 지적이라며, 이름을 calculateTotal로 바꾸고 몇 분 안에 수정본을 올리겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You thank them for spotting it and will upload the renamed version in a few minutes.

intent.ko: 이미 롤백했고 원인을 찾는 중이라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the release is already reverted and you are still looking for the cause.

tr_dev_002.sample_en: We already rolled it back, and the error rate is normal. Now we're finding the root cause.

sample_gloss.ko: 이미 롤백해서 오류율은 정상으로 돌아왔고, 지금 근본 원인을 찾고 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The release is reverted, failures are back to normal, and you are looking for the real reason.

intent.ko: API 권한이 없어 막혀 있다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say your work is stuck because you still can't use the other team's API.

tr_dev_003.sample_en: Yes, I'm blocked on API access from the platform team. Could someone help me follow up?

sample_gloss.ko: 플랫폼팀의 API 권한 때문에 막혀 있으니, 누가 확인을 도와줄 수 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You are stuck waiting for the platform team's permission and ask if anyone can help chase it.

intent.ko: 3일쯤 걸리고 테스트는 따로라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Give a rough number of days and mention that testing needs extra time.

tr_dev_004.sample_en: Roughly three days, not including testing. I'd add a buffer for the API changes.

sample_gloss.ko: 테스트를 빼고 대략 3일이며, API 변경에 대비해 여유를 두고 싶다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: About three days without testing, plus some extra time in case the API changes.

intent.ko: 오래된 데이터 처리 방법이 궁금하다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask how the design deals with data that is out of date.

tr_dev_005.sample_en: Nice work. How would we handle stale data? Could you walk me through that part?

sample_gloss.ko: 잘했다고 한 뒤, 오래된 데이터는 어떻게 처리하는지 그 부분을 설명해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You praise the work and ask them to explain step by step what happens with out-of-date data.

intent.ko: 좋다며 먼저 테스트부터 쓰자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Agree to drive and suggest writing a test before anything else.

tr_dev_006.sample_en: Sure, I'll take over. Let's write a test first, and stop me if I miss anything.

sample_gloss.ko: 제가 이어서 하겠다며, 먼저 테스트를 쓰고 빠뜨린 게 있으면 말해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You will continue from here, start with a test, and ask them to tell you when you miss something.

intent.ko: 일부 안드로이드 사용자만 영향받는다고 말해보세요
intent.en: In simple words, say only some Android users are hit and when it will be fixed.

tr_dev_007.sample_en: It only affects older Android phones, about 5% of users. We'll have a fix by Friday.

sample_gloss.ko: 구형 안드로이드폰, 약 5% 사용자에게만 영향이 있고 금요일까지 고치겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The bug is limited to old Android devices, about 5% of users, and will be repaired by Friday.

intent.ko: 알림은 해결됐고 하나만 지켜보라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say last night's alert is resolved but one thing still needs watching.

tr_dev_008.sample_en: One alert fired once around 2 a.m., and it's resolved. Just keep an eye on disk usage.

sample_gloss.ko: 새벽 2시쯤 알림이 한 번 울렸지만 해결됐고, 디스크 사용량만 지켜봐 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: An alert went off around 2 a.m. and was fixed, but they should watch the storage space.

intent.ko: 관리 상태와 크기, 두 가지 이유를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give two reasons: it is still updated often and it is much smaller.

tr_dev_009.sample_en: The main reason is that it's actively maintained. It's also half the size of ours.

sample_gloss.ko: 가장 큰 이유는 꾸준히 관리된다는 점이고, 크기도 지금 쓰는 것의 절반이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The key point is that it is still updated often, and it is 50% smaller than the current one.

intent.ko: 새 기능 하나와 버그 수정 두 개를 말해보세요
intent.en: Mention one new feature and the two problems that were fixed.

tr_dev_010.sample_en: This release adds dark mode, plus two bug fixes for login and search.

sample_gloss.ko: 이번 버전에는 다크 모드가 추가됐고, 로그인과 검색 버그 두 개를 고쳤다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The new version brings a dark theme and repairs two problems in login and search.

intent.ko: 가장 큰 고민부터 듣고 싶다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you want to hear how they work now and what their main problem is.

tr_sales_001.sample_en: I'd love to hear how you handle orders today. What's the biggest challenge right now?

sample_gloss.ko: 지금 주문을 어떻게 처리하는지, 가장 큰 어려움이 무엇인지 듣고 싶다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You want to learn how they manage orders now and what their main problem is.

intent.ko: 차이를 인정하고 아껴 주는 비용을 말해보세요
intent.en: Accept that it costs more, then explain the savings it brings.

tr_sales_002.sample_en: I understand. But it saves you about ten hours a week, so it pays for itself over a year.

sample_gloss.ko: 이해한다고 한 뒤, 주당 약 10시간을 아껴 주니 1년이면 비용이 회수된다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You accept the point, then explain it cuts about ten hours a week and pays back within twelve months.

intent.ko: 추가 자료를 보내겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Offer to send more material and invite their questions.

tr_sales_003.sample_en: Sure. I can send over our pricing sheet today. Any questions so far?

sample_gloss.ko: 오늘 가격표를 보내 줄 수 있다며 지금까지 궁금한 점이 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You offer to email the price list today and ask if anything is unclear so far.

intent.ko: 감사를 전하고 소개를 부탁한다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Thank them and ask whether they know another team who could use it.

tr_sales_004.sample_en: That means a lot. Is there anyone else in your network who might benefit from this?

sample_gloss.ko: 큰 힘이 된다며, 주변에 이 서비스가 도움이 될 만한 분이 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You thank them warmly and ask if another person they know could find it useful.

intent.ko: 클릭은 좋았지만 전환은 낮았다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say many people clicked, but few of them actually bought.

tr_sales_005.sample_en: The click rate was above target, but conversions were low. We're testing a new page.

sample_gloss.ko: 클릭률은 목표보다 높았지만 전환은 낮아서 새 페이지를 시험 중이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Many people clicked, better than planned, but few bought, so you are trying a new page.

intent.ko: 회사가 하는 일을 한 줄로 말해보세요
intent.en: Introduce your company in one short sentence and offer to show something.

tr_sales_006.sample_en: Hi! We make smart sensors for factories. Let me show you how they work.

sample_gloss.ko: 공장용 스마트 센서를 만든다고 소개하고, 작동 방식을 보여 주겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Your company builds connected sensors for factories, and you offer to demo them.

intent.ko: 사용률을 같이 높여 보자고 말해보세요
intent.en: Thank them for being honest and offer free training to raise usage.

tr_sales_007.sample_en: Thanks for being upfront. Could we run a free training session before you decide?

sample_gloss.ko: 솔직히 말해 줘서 고맙다며, 결정 전에 무료 교육을 한번 해 보자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You appreciate the honesty and suggest a no-cost workshop ahead of their decision.

intent.ko: 할인은 어렵지만 다른 혜택을 준다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the price stays the same, but offer something else of value.

tr_sales_008.sample_en: I can't move on price, but what I can do is add an extra month of support for free.

sample_gloss.ko: 가격은 조정이 어렵지만 대신 지원 기간을 한 달 무료로 늘려 줄 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The price is fixed, but you can offer one more month of support at no cost.

intent.ko: 목표 고객과 원하는 결과를 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain who you want to reach and what result you want.

tr_sales_009.sample_en: The main goal is to get people in their 30s to sign up for a free trial.

sample_gloss.ko: 가장 큰 목표는 30대가 무료 체험에 가입하게 만드는 것이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: What you want most is for adults aged 30 to 39 to register for a free trial.

intent.ko: 이름과 하는 일, 온 이유를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give your name, your job, and why you came, in a few words.

tr_sales_010.sample_en: Nice to meet you, I'm Jin. I work in sales, and I'm looking to meet new partners.

sample_gloss.ko: 만나서 반갑다며, 영업 일을 하고 새 파트너를 만나러 왔다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You say hello, mention your sales job, and say you are hoping to connect with new partners.

intent.ko: 다음 스프린트에 넣겠다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say it can't fit now, but it will be first in line next time.

tr_pm_001.sample_en: This sprint is full, but I'll put it at the top of the list for next sprint.

sample_gloss.ko: 이번 스프린트는 꽉 찼지만 다음 스프린트 맨 위에 넣겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: There is no room in this cycle, but it will be first in line for the following one.

intent.ko: 기능 하나를 빼면 날짜를 지킨다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you can keep the date if one feature moves to a later release.

tr_pm_002.sample_en: We can hit the date if we move the export feature to phase two.

sample_gloss.ko: 내보내기 기능을 2단계로 옮기면 출시 날짜를 맞출 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You can meet the deadline if the export feature is pushed into the second release.

intent.ko: 외부 승인 때문에 늦어진다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain that you need an outside approval, and give the new date.

tr_pm_003.sample_en: We're waiting on approval from the payment provider. The new date is May 20.

sample_gloss.ko: 결제 대행사의 승인을 기다리는 중이고, 새 출시 날짜는 5월 20일이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You still need sign-off from the payment company, and it will now launch on May 20.

intent.ko: 평소처럼 써 보시면 된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say any answer is fine and ask them to use the app the usual way.

tr_pm_004.sample_en: There's no right or wrong. Just show me how you book a room, as you normally would.

sample_gloss.ko: 정답은 없으니 평소처럼 회의실을 예약하는 과정을 보여 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Any answer is fine, so they should simply let you see how they book a room the usual way.

intent.ko: 끝낸 것 두 개와 넘어간 것 하나를 말해보세요
intent.en: Name two finished items and one that moved to the next sprint.

tr_pm_005.sample_en: We shipped filters and saved lists. Sharing was carried over due to a design change.

sample_gloss.ko: 필터와 저장 목록은 출시했고, 공유 기능은 디자인 변경 때문에 넘겼다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You released filters and saved lists, and sharing moved forward because of a design change.

intent.ko: 무엇이 왜 바뀌었는지 짧게 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain the one key change and the reason behind it.

tr_pm_006.sample_en: The main change is one sign-up page instead of three, based on feedback from users.

sample_gloss.ko: 사용자 피드백을 반영해서 가입 화면을 세 장 대신 한 장으로 바꿨다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The biggest difference is a single sign-up page rather than three, because users asked for it.

intent.ko: 지금은 어렵고 대안이 있다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say no for now, explain why, and suggest a workaround.

tr_pm_007.sample_en: It's not on our roadmap this quarter. In the meantime, the export tool could cover it.

sample_gloss.ko: 이번 분기 로드맵에는 없고, 그동안은 내보내기 기능으로 해결할 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It is not in your plan for these three months, but until then the export tool could help.

intent.ko: 대략 얼마나 걸릴지 알려 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask for a rough idea of how long it would take.

tr_pm_008.sample_en: Could I get a rough estimate for the new alerts by Thursday?

sample_gloss.ko: 새 알림 기능에 대한 대략적인 기간 예상을 목요일까지 받을 수 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask for a ballpark number for the notification feature no later than Thursday.

intent.ko: 베타는 3분기, 정식은 연말이라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the timing for the test version first, then for everyone.

tr_pm_009.sample_en: We plan a beta in the third quarter, with a full launch by the end of the year.

sample_gloss.ko: 3분기에 베타를 내고, 연말까지 정식 출시할 계획이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: A test version comes in Q3, and the release to everyone is planned by year-end.

intent.ko: 잘된 점 하나와 고마운 사람을 말해보세요
intent.en: Share one good thing and credit the person who made it happen.

tr_pm_010.sample_en: The daily check-ins went really well, thanks to Mina for keeping them short.

sample_gloss.ko: 매일 짧은 점검이 정말 잘됐고, 짧게 진행해 준 미나 덕분이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Your short daily meetings worked great because Mina kept them brief.

intent.ko: 가능한 시간 두 개를 말해보세요
intent.en: Offer two time slots and let them choose.

tr_hr_001.sample_en: How about Tuesday or Wednesday at 9 a.m. Korea time? Whichever works for you.

sample_gloss.ko: 한국 시간 화요일이나 수요일 오전 9시 중 편한 쪽으로 고르라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You offer Tuesday or Wednesday at 9 a.m. in Seoul and let them pick the one they prefer.

intent.ko: 오늘은 서류, 내일부터 교육이라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say today is for forms and getting set up, and training starts tomorrow.

tr_hr_002.sample_en: Today is mostly paperwork and setup. Starting tomorrow, you'll have training each morning.

sample_gloss.ko: 오늘은 주로 서류와 장비 세팅이고, 내일부터는 매일 아침 교육이 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: For today it's largely forms and getting ready, and from tomorrow on there's training every morning.

intent.ko: 15일이고 5일까지 이월된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the number of days and explain the limit on moving them to next year.

tr_hr_003.sample_en: You get 15 days a year, and you can carry over up to five into next year.

sample_gloss.ko: 1년에 15일이 있고, 그중 최대 5일까지 다음 해로 이월할 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You have fifteen days a year and can move no more than five to the next year.

intent.ko: 수리를 불렀으니 다른 방을 쓰라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say a repair is on the way and suggest another room for now.

tr_hr_004.sample_en: I've already called the repair team. They'll come this afternoon, so please use Room C.

sample_gloss.ko: 이미 수리팀을 불렀고 오후에 오니 그동안 C 회의실을 써 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You have contacted the repair team, they come later today, and they should move to Room C.

intent.ko: 배우자도 되지만 신청 기한이 있다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say spouses are included, but there is a deadline to apply.

tr_hr_005.sample_en: Yes, it covers your spouse. Just sign up by March 31 on the HR portal.

sample_gloss.ko: 배우자도 포함되니 3월 31일까지 인사 포털에서 신청하라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It does include their spouse; they need to register before March 31 on the HR website.

intent.ko: 함께 일한 기간과 강점이 궁금하다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Thank them, then ask about the period they worked together and what she does best.

tr_hr_006.sample_en: Thanks for your time. How long did you work with her, and what are her main strengths?

sample_gloss.ko: 시간 내 줘서 고맙다며, 얼마나 함께 일했고 주요 강점이 무엇인지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You appreciate them taking the call and ask about the period they worked together and what she does best.

intent.ko: 후보 날짜와 투표 마감을 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the possible dates and say when the vote closes.

tr_hr_007.sample_en: Not yet. We have two options, June 12 or 19. Please vote in the poll by Friday.

sample_gloss.ko: 아직이고, 6월 12일과 19일 두 후보 중 금요일까지 투표해 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: There are a couple of choices, June 12 or 19, and they should choose in the poll before the weekend.

intent.ko: 필요한 서류 두 가지와 기한을 말해보세요
intent.en: Name the two documents and say when you need them.

tr_hr_008.sample_en: We need a copy of your passport and your degree certificate by next Monday.

sample_gloss.ko: 다음 주 월요일까지 여권 사본과 학위 증명서가 필요하다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You need a scan of their passport and proof of their degree before Monday next week.

intent.ko: 출장 중 화상 면담도 된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the date can't change, but video meetings during the trip are fine.

tr_hr_009.sample_en: The deadline is fixed, but you can do them over video or before you leave.

sample_gloss.ko: 기한은 바꿀 수 없지만 화상으로 하거나 출장 전에 해도 된다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The date can't change, but they can hold them on a video call or ahead of the trip.

intent.ko: 시작일과 바뀌는 핵심 하나를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the start date and the one main change.

gloss.en: starting on the first of March

tr_hr_010.sample_en: It takes effect from March 1. The key change is two office days a week.

sample_gloss.ko: 3월 1일부터 시행되고, 핵심은 주 2일 사무실 출근이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It begins on the first of March, and the main change is two days at the office each week.

intent.ko: 차액은 송금 수수료일 수 있다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the gap may be a transfer charge and promise to check.

tr_finance_001.sample_en: The difference might be a bank fee. Let me confirm with our bank and get back to you.

sample_gloss.ko: 차액은 은행 수수료일 수 있으니 은행에 확인하고 다시 연락하겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The gap could be a transfer charge, so you'll check with the bank and reply.

intent.ko: 금액과 줄어드는 작업 시간을 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the cost and explain how much time it will save.

tr_finance_002.sample_en: It costs about $12,000 a year, and it would cut closing time by three days.

sample_gloss.ko: 1년에 약 1만 2천 달러가 들고, 월 마감을 사흘 줄여 준다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It is priced around $12,000 annually and would shorten month-end work by three days.

intent.ko: 영수증이 있으면 된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say yes, provided they have proof of payment.

tr_finance_003.sample_en: Yes, as long as you keep the receipts. Submit them within two weeks.

sample_gloss.ko: 영수증만 있으면 되고, 2주 안에 제출하라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Yes, provided that they save proof of payment and send it in within two weeks.

intent.ko: 하루 늦어진다고 이유와 함께 말해보세요
intent.en: Say it will be a day behind and briefly explain why.

tr_finance_004.sample_en: It'll be one day late, sorry. We're still waiting for sales data from the Busan branch.

sample_gloss.ko: 부산 지점의 매출 자료를 아직 기다리고 있어서 하루 늦어진다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It will be a day behind because sales data from the Busan office has not arrived.

intent.ko: 일회성 비용 때문이라고 이유를 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain that most of it came from a single expense.

tr_finance_005.sample_en: It's mainly due to a one-time cost for the expo. We'll be back on budget next quarter.

sample_gloss.ko: 주로 박람회 일회성 비용 때문이고, 다음 분기에는 예산 안으로 돌아온다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Mostly because of a single expense for the expo, and spending will be within plan again next quarter.

intent.ko: 대부분은 내일, 나머지는 금요일이라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the majority will come tomorrow and what's left later this week.

tr_finance_006.sample_en: I can send most of them tomorrow. The rest need a signature, so by Friday.

sample_gloss.ko: 대부분은 내일 보내고, 나머지는 서명이 필요해서 금요일까지 보내겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The majority go out tomorrow, and what's left needs a signature, so no later than Friday.

intent.ko: 기준은 45일이지만 조기 지급도 된다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain your usual policy, then mention an option to pay sooner.

tr_finance_007.sample_en: Our standard terms are net 45. We could pay sooner with an early payment discount.

sample_gloss.ko: 기준 조건은 45일 후 지급이지만, 조기 지급 할인을 해 주면 더 빨리 낼 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Your usual policy is payment in 45 days, but you could pay sooner for a small reduction.

intent.ko: 달러 환율이 올라서라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain that it is mostly because the dollar got stronger.

tr_finance_008.sample_en: Mostly the exchange rate. The dollar went up about 5% against the won.

sample_gloss.ko: 주로 환율 때문이고, 달러가 원화 대비 약 5% 올랐다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Mostly the currency rate: the dollar rose roughly five percent compared with the won.

intent.ko: 번호가 틀렸으니 다시 보내 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Point out the wrong number and ask them to send it again.

tr_finance_009.sample_en: Yes, the tax ID is incorrect. Could you send us a corrected invoice?

sample_gloss.ko: 사업자 번호가 틀렸으니 수정한 청구서를 다시 보내 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The business number is wrong, so you ask them to send a fixed bill.

intent.ko: 위험 요인을 들어 신중하게 말해보세요
intent.en: Say you would rather stay cautious and name the main risk.

tr_finance_010.sample_en: I'd be careful. The biggest risk is weaker demand in Europe, so maybe a smaller increase.

sample_gloss.ko: 유럽 수요 둔화가 가장 큰 위험이라 신중하고 싶고, 조금만 올리자는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You'd rather be cautious because demand in Europe may drop, so you suggest a lower raise.

intent.ko: 품목과 수량, 납품 장소를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the item, the quantity, and where it should be shipped.

tr_trade_001.sample_en: We'd like a quote for five thousand units of the blue cases, delivered to Busan.

sample_gloss.ko: 파란 케이스 5천 개를 부산으로 납품하는 조건의 견적을 원한다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You want pricing for 5,000 blue cases shipped to Busan.

intent.ko: 일부라도 먼저 보내 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say it hurts your plans and ask them to ship part of the order first.

tr_trade_002.sample_en: That's a problem for us. Could you send a partial shipment by the original date?

sample_gloss.ko: 곤란하다며 원래 날짜까지 일부라도 먼저 보내 줄 수 있는지 묻는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: It hurts your plans, so you ask for part of the order on the planned date.

intent.ko: 파손 수량과 사진이 있다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say how many cartons were ruined and that you have pictures.

tr_trade_003.sample_en: Twelve boxes have water damage. I've emailed you the details with photos attached.

sample_gloss.ko: 12상자가 물에 젖어 손상됐고, 사진을 첨부해 이메일로 보냈다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: A dozen cartons got wet and were ruined, and you've emailed details with pictures included.

intent.ko: 선적 후엔 구매자 책임이라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Explain that the buyer takes over once the cargo is loaded.

tr_trade_004.sample_en: Under FOB, once the goods are on board, insurance is on our side as the buyer.

sample_gloss.ko: FOB 조건에서는 물건이 배에 실린 뒤 보험은 구매자인 저희 책임이라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: With FOB terms, after the cargo is loaded, insurance is your responsibility as the buyer.

intent.ko: 원산지 증명서가 빠졌다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say one certificate wasn't included and ask them to email it right away.

gloss.en: proof of where it was made

tr_trade_005.sample_en: The certificate of origin is missing. Could you email it as soon as possible?

sample_gloss.ko: 원산지 증명서가 빠져 있으니 최대한 빨리 이메일로 보내 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The proof of where it was made wasn't included, so you ask them to email it right away.

intent.ko: 색이 달라 새 샘플이 필요하다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the color doesn't match your order and ask for a new one.

tr_trade_006.sample_en: The color is a bit darker than we ordered. Could you send another sample?

sample_gloss.ko: 색이 주문한 것보다 조금 어두우니 샘플을 다시 보내 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The color is slightly too dark compared to your order, so you ask for a new one.

intent.ko: 첫 주문만 3천 개로 해 달라고 말해보세요
intent.en: Ask them to accept a smaller trial order and mention bigger volumes later.

tr_trade_007.sample_en: Could you accept three thousand units for a first order? We'd plan larger orders later.

sample_gloss.ko: 첫 주문은 3천 개로 받아 주면 나중에 더 큰 주문을 하겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You ask them to take 3,000 pieces as a trial and promise bigger volumes after that.

intent.ko: 불량률과 원하는 조치를 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the share of faulty items and say what you want them to do.

tr_trade_008.sample_en: The defect rate was eight percent. We need a root cause report by next week.

sample_gloss.ko: 불량률이 8%였으니 다음 주까지 원인 분석 보고서를 달라는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: Eight out of 100 items were faulty, so you want an explanation of why by next week.

intent.ko: 날짜와 함께 갈 인원을 말해보세요
intent.en: Give the dates and how many people are coming.

tr_trade_009.sample_en: We're thinking the week of May 12. Two of us will come to see the production line.

sample_gloss.ko: 5월 12일이 있는 주에 두 명이 생산 라인을 보러 가겠다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: You plan the week starting May 12, and a pair of you will visit the factory floor.

intent.ko: 이틀 전 송금했고 증빙을 보낸다고 말해보세요
intent.en: Say the money went out two days ago and you'll share proof.

tr_trade_010.sample_en: We wired it on Monday. I'll send the remittance slip; it can take two to three days.

sample_gloss.ko: 월요일에 송금했고 송금 증빙을 보내 줄 테니, 2~3일 걸릴 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
sample_gloss.en: The money went out Monday, you'll share the transfer receipt, and it may take a few business days.
